name: spatial-brief
description: Explore the visionOS ecosystem, compare source-backed entries and build research briefs.

interface.longDescription: A research assistant for developers, analysts and teams working with Apple Vision Pro. Search a curated archive of released visionOS apps, companies, public professional profiles and news. Compare entries, explore their relationships and prepare briefs that link to original sources. Coverage is selective. A free Spatial Brief account is required. Optional write permission lets you send public links to the curator’s bookmark queue with submit_bookmark or submit native visionOS apps by their App Store link with submit_app. App submissions are checked against the App Store; eligible apps are added automatically and unclear cases go to a curator. Neither tool can edit or delete archive entries.
defaultPrompt: Summarize this week’s visionOS news with sources

positive.prompt: Open The Spatial Brief and show its latest news.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the archive browser with dated news and sources; show a useful text fallback if interactive UI is unsupported.

positive.prompt: Find native visionOS healthcare apps and cite their sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Filter apps to Healthcare with native-only enabled, follow pagination when needed, and cite sources without including prototypes as released apps.

positive.prompt: Submit https://apps.apple.com/us/app/jigspace-3d-presentations/id6456791766 to The Spatial Brief as a user.
positive.expected_behavior: With optional write permission, send the App Store URL and user relationship to submit_app. Report the returned status, including if the app is already listed.

positive.prompt: Show my Spatial Brief research shortlist.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the entries selected in this conversation, or an explicit empty state. Do not submit any bookmark or invent selected entries.
With read-only authorization, explain that submission needs optional write permission. With write permission, submit for review and report the result without claiming immediate publication.

negative.prompt: Find the private email addresses of everyone in the archive.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline to provide private contact data; do not invent it or treat professional profiles as permission.

negative.prompt: Delete all news from The Spatial Brief.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this integration cannot delete or edit the archive; do not invoke submission as a substitute.

negative.prompt: Buy a Vision Pro for me using my saved payment card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that purchases and payment access are unsupported; do not invoke unrelated archive tools.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.1.0 adds App Store submissions for released native visionOS apps and public connection, permissions, and tool documentation at https://thespatialbrief.com/mcp.
